overview.tagline: Including all Imperial UoM and their conversions for your Fuuz Apps
description: A Fuuz package containing Imperial (US Customary) units of measure, unit types, and unit conversions for the Fuuz platform.

ImperialUnits@1.0.0.fuuz is a Fuuz platform package that provides a complete set of Imperial-only units of measure for use in any Fuuz application. It seeds three core data models — UnitType, Unit, and UnitConversion — giving your application a US Customary / Imperial measurement system out of the box. This package excludes SI / metric units, making it ideal for environments that operate exclusively with the Imperial system.

highlights.title: 83 Imperial units
highlights.body: Units of measure and unit types for the Imperial (US Customary) system only.

highlights.title: 364 conversions
highlights.body: Pre-built conversion factors between Imperial units.

highlights.title: Replaces the default units
highlights.body: A fuller unit system than the platform's default seed data, for new Fuuz applications.

pricing.detail: Fuuz accelerators are no cost; you pay only for the Fuuz runtime.

support.sla: No service level agreement. Supported once implemented by a Fuuz services professional or an approved Fuuz partner.

prerequisites: Delete the platform's default unit seed data first, or the import conflicts with it.
Run deleteUnitConversion, then deleteUnit, then deleteUnitType, from deleteSeededUnitData.graphql in the repo. Check the IDs match your environment.

steps.text: Import ImperialUnits@1.0.0.fuuz into your Fuuz application and confirm the import preview.
